label: Tritonia sea slug

models.label: E010 — YOLO26s, sea slugs in grayscale 6-camera timelapse frames
models.description: Trained on 96 frames (572 slugs) from 10 days of one lab/field camera setup, 2013. Boxes are a fixed 20x17 px square on each hand-clicked slug.
models.declared_source: val_eval_record.json, max point F1 on val

sources.label: val samples — used for tuning (labelled)
sources.note: 9 frames from the 3 val days, used to choose the checkpoint and the confidence threshold.

sources.label: test samples — held out (labelled)
sources.note: 9 frames from the 3 test days; never used for training or tuning, evaluated once.

sources.label: unseen samples (unlabelled)
sources.note: 10 frames from 2013-05-18, a day with no labels that was in no split; same camera setup.

limitations: Only one camera setup: other sites, cameras or colour video are untested.
Finds about half the slugs: test recall 0.24, precision 0.36 at conf 0.16.
Much worse on dark or crowded days (val day 2013-05-24 F1 0.15).
Boxes are fixed-size squares, so box size and shape mean nothing.
Grayscale timelapse (15 s per frame), not video; no size or speed in real units.
Class 0 'lobster' is an unused slot; ignore it.
